summary: Blocks stylesheet content from using a reading-measure max-width of 60 to 85ch or a --measure variable.
doc: This hook denies a write to a stylesheet or component file when it caps content to a reading measure. It checks max-width set to a --measure, --prose, --reading or --readable variable. It also checks max-width between 60ch and 85ch, or between 550px and 759px in a file with prose-like selectors. A second narrower cap inside an already bounded column leaves unused space beside the content. Set the width once on the page shell or grid track. This rule reflects a house layout opinion, so install it only when the page already bounds its content columns.
